scope.colRootAudit: No exact COL26.8 usage node named Glaucophyta exists in the complete pinned hierarchy; no strict COL partition is claimed.
scope.boundary: This ITIS-only sidecar retains every current species below the accepted ITIS Glaucophyta division. It deliberately contains no COL match rows until a pinned COL release materializes an exact auditable Glaucophyta root.

rootBoundaryAudit.decision: The pinned ITIS export has exact accepted Glaucophyta division TSN 846495; COL26.8 has no exact Glaucophyta usage node. Only the ITIS division is retained; no near COL root is substituted.

normalization: Remove the exact trailing COL authorship field from COL scientificName when that suffix is present; no authorship parser is used.
Normalize Unicode to NFC, replace underscores with spaces, collapse Unicode whitespace and trim.
For species-rank comparison, remove one parenthesized subgenus token in the exact Genus (Subgenus) species representation; genus and specific epithet must remain unchanged.
Preserve case, diacritics, punctuation and all remaining name tokens.

exactMatching.prohibited: No inferred COL scope, fuzzy match, edit-distance, phonetic, case-folded, diacritic-stripped, token-reordered or taxon-substituted matching is used.

evidenceBoundary.en: This CC0 ITIS inventory is a frozen, ITIS-only nomenclatural partition. It is not a global Glaucophyta checklist, a final classification authority, a phylogeny, a species-concept equivalence assertion, a biological dossier or a scientific-review record.
evidenceBoundary.zh: 此 CC0 ITIS 清单是冻结的、仅限 ITIS 的命名分区；它不是全球蓝藻门（Glaucophyta）名录、最终分类权威、系统发育、物种概念等同性声明、生物档案或科学审查记录。
